new.n: Charles B. Springer Hotel, bay shore north of Menominee (1912 atlas)
new.pl: bay shore of sec. 7 T32N R26W, Menominee County
new.v: Coins, jewelry, resort-era bottles and tokens
new.st: The 1912 Standard Atlas of Menominee County shows the Charles B. Springer Hotel, "located four miles from Menominee on the Bay Shore", under construction in 1911-12. Its advertising page says it opened among evergreens with a 40-acre lakeside. The atlas's patron directory lists Chas. B. Springer, farmer and lumber manufacturer, at sec. 7 T32N R26W, so the pin sits on that section's Green Bay shore. Where the hotel stood within the shore lots is not yet known.
new.t: Look for the hotel foundation, the drive and the beach front along the shore lots, with resort-era bottles and coins. Ask the landowner first.
src: Standard Atlas of Menominee County, Michigan (Geo. A. Ogle and Co., Chicago, 1912): hotel photo page, advertising section and patron directory
pinev: Placed on the Green Bay shore of sec. 7 T32N R26W from the patron directory; the hotel can be anywhere along about 1 km of shore
